title: Experimental Badge
summary: A badge that opens the concrete risks of a beta feature and a one-tap way back to the stable version, so people don't trust it blindly.
description: The badge opens a plain list of concrete risks (work may be lost, things may change or disappear), a feedback link and a one-tap switch back to the stable version that says what happens to their work.
catches: Unclear risk of using an unfinished feature
No way back, by offering a switch to stable
What happens to work when switching back
limits: Lists the risks you write; it can't know them
a11y: The badge is a button with aria-expanded and a descriptive aria-label
The panel is role="dialog" with an aria-label
stops: Trusted a beta feature and lost work
